text.p: Anaconda Nickel Ltd said on Wednesday it had hired an official of MIM Holdings Ltd, Stephen Dennis, as general manager of its Murrin Murrin nickel project.

Dennis is currently general manager of commercial activities for MIM's Mount Isa operations and has been involved in the Ernest henry copper and gold project as a member of its management committee, Anaconda said.

Anaconda said Dennis will report directly to the joint venture committee of Murrin Murrin, comprising senior executives of Anaconda and Glencore International AG, a 40 percent stakeholder in the Western Australia project.
Murrin Murrin, 50 km east of the mining community of Leonora, is being developed at a cost of around A$780 million.
It is forecast to produce about 100 million pounds of nickel a year once it is fully operational in mid-1998.
